description: This header file declares internal API functions for managing a UInt Array object, including operations such as getting size, setting size, inserting, removing, and finding elements within the array.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayGetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the UInt Array.

methods.name: AnscUIntArraySetSize
methods.description: Sets a new size for the UInt Array, possibly enlarging its storage.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayRemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all elements from the array.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayGetAt
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specified index.

methods.name: AnscUIntArraySetAt
methods.description: Sets the element at a specified index.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayInsertAt
methods.description: Inserts elements at a specified index.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayRemoveAt
methods.description: Removes elements starting at a specified index.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayAdd
methods.description: Adds a new element to the array.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayEnlargeStorage
methods.description: Enlarges the internal storage to accommodate more elements.

methods.name: AnscUIntArrayFind
methods.description: Finds the index of a specified element.
